boards.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. High-fidelity mobile UX review board for the existing app Trust Tambola. Preserve its deep plum #290435, violet #76207d and warm gold #efd080 branding, an understated lotus mark, warm ivory #fffaf2 paper ticket cards, dark readable text. Family-and-friends game, friendly elegant tactile paper feeling, restrained gradients, no money or betting. Clean mobile product typography, large accessible buttons, 8px spacing rhythm, rounded 20px cards. Landscape high-resolution 3840x2160 image containing EXACTLY FOUR complete tall mobile screen artboards side-by-side, straight on, not angled; each phone aspect about 390:844, large enough to read. Small board title at top, screen number and title above each. Uniform pale lilac board background and subtle device borders. Crisp readable exact English UI text. Plenty of space, no overlapping elements. Each panel is a distinct screen/state; no extra inset phones. Visually consistent across all screens. This is a proposal for review, not an implemented app screenshot.
Board title: "TRUST TAMBOLA / 01 — Get together"
Screen 01 "Home": deep plum background, gold Trust wordmark with TAMBOLA subtitle and small lotus. Hero line "Your people. Your game." A compact tasteful ticket and number balls illustration. Large gold primary "Play online" with small text "Friends & family"; secondary ivory-outlined "Offline caller" with "Play without signing in". Bottom secondary small Settings, Share, Account buttons. Online entry must be prominent on home.
Screen 02 "Play online": plum header, white/ivory body. Heading "Make room for everyone". Two mode cards "Private table" selected with lock icon and "Invite your friends & family"; "Public table" visibly disabled with a "Coming soon" pill. Primary gold button "Create table". Secondary purple-outline "Join with table code". Profile chip "Playing as Priya". Small quiet line "Just for fun, together."
Screen 03 "Your player profile": back arrow, title "Join your people". Intro "Set up your profile to play online". Friendly initial avatar P with edit pencil, labelled Name field "Priya", labelled Mobile number field "+91 00000 00000" (illustrative number). Outline action "Choose number from SIM" with tiny "Android, when available". Small copy "No SMS code. Your number is self-declared." Tickbox "Share my number with this private table". Helper "Members can see your name, number and live ticket." Gold "Create player profile". Footer "Already have a profile? Sign in". Do not show verified phone badge, no OTP SMS input.
Screen 04 "Create table": header "Create a table", "Private games, familiar faces." field Table name with "Sunday Family". Visibility cards Private selected, Public disabled "Coming soon". Rule row "Winning pattern" value "Full house"; row "Call interval" value "8 seconds". Small review note "Everyone readies up. Everyone reviews claims." Gold bottom button "Create private table". No actual room code yet.
